flora: Rimu 'Cone' (a small black seed sitting atop a bright red-to-orange fleshy base/aril)
Weeping Foliage (juvenile leaves are long and needle-like, mature leaves are tiny scales on drooping branchlets)
Rimu sapling (very distinctive weeping shape, looking like a green waterfall)
Bark detail (dark brown-grey bark that flakes off in thick, wavy 'scales' or 'shingles')
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the drooping, cascading lines of the foliage; vibrant red of the seed base; tactile 'shingle-like' bark; clear quadrant separation.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: The red fleshy seed base; Top-Right: A spray of drooping, weeping foliage; Bottom-Left: A 'waterfall' shaped sapling; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of the wavy, flaking bark.
visual_logic.ground: Damp red-brown mudstone with a light cover of dark brown organic debris.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to accentuate the saturated red of the fruit-like cones.
